guidance.when: The source regulates return, destruction, delivery, deletion, or retention of protected information at an ending event or on request.
guidance.inspection: Match actor, protected object, trigger, and every exception in the operative text. Establish each branch from the source; survival, duration, or a nearby ending date alone is insufficient, and no match remains unresolved.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Include the duty chapeau, exact trigger, all operative return/destruction alternatives, and any retention proviso.

branches.when: A receiving party must return or destroy covered information when the agreement, project, evaluation, discussions, relationship, or equivalent covered activity ends.
branches.inspection: Confirm the ending event activates the disposition duty. A request-only duty or general survival clause does not qualify; a closing delivery qualifies only when it ends the covered relationship.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the receiving actor, ending trigger, protected material, and complete return or destruction duty.

branches.when: A disposition regime expressly permits keeping backups, inaccessible system copies, or legal, regulatory, evidentiary, tax, or compliance copies.
branches.inspection: Confirm present permission to retain specified protected material despite the disposition duty, preserving access, purpose, duration, and continuing-confidentiality limits.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the disposition rule and each operative retention exception with its conditions.

branches.when: The applicable rule requires return or destruction of all protected information and copies without a retention exception.
branches.inspection: Require exhaustive coverage; duties limited to documents, tangible items, or selected media do not oppose retention of other protected information.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the trigger and language covering all protected information and copies, plus any incorporated proviso.

guidance.when: The source regulates reverse engineering, copying, or proprietary rights in protected information.
guidance.inspection: Keep each action and polarity separate, and check immediate exceptions before selecting a relation. Absence of an exact operative rule is unresolved.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Include the actor, protected object, operative verb, polarity, and applicable consent or purpose qualification.

branches.when: The receiving party is expressly barred from reverse engineering protected information, including a prohibition subject to written consent.
branches.inspection: Verify the prohibition concerns reverse engineering rather than copying, disclosure, or ordinary use.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the complete reverse-engineering prohibition and consent qualification.

branches.when: The agreement expressly conveys no licence, ownership, title, or proprietary right, or reserves those rights to the discloser.
branches.inspection: A use, disclosure, or copying restriction alone is not a no-rights clause; a limited contractual use or retention permission does not itself oppose the hypothesis.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show each operative no-rights, no-licence, ownership, or reservation provision.

branches.when: Copying is expressly allowed or necessarily authorized for a stated purpose, permitted disclosure, performance need, or automatic backup.
branches.inspection: Treat a present necessary-purpose exception as permission. Future consent alone and retention of existing copies are not permission to create copies.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the copy rule, present exception or automatic-copy route, and its purpose conditions.

branches.when: Copying is prohibited, including unless prior approval is later obtained, and no present copy exception applies.
branches.inspection: Do not convert possible future consent, permitted use, employee disclosure, or retention into current copying permission.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the complete no-copy rule and every proviso bearing on copying.

guidance.when: The source defines what information qualifies as confidential and how its status is established.
guidance.inspection: Read the entire definition, incorporated continuations, modalities, and alternative eligibility routes. Establish the exact branch; silence is not opposition.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Include the definitional chapeau and all text needed to connect the category, modality, or identification condition to confidential status.

branches.when: Every covered disclosure form must be marked or identified by the disclosing party, with any oral form requiring timely identification or written confirmation.
branches.inspection: Test written, oral, electronic, and other routes; entailment requires identification to be universal.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show all clauses collectively covering every disclosure form and identification step.

branches.when: Nature, circumstances, reasonable understanding, or an express unmarked-information rule can independently confer confidential status.
branches.inspection: Require an affirmative alternative to discloser identification; broad wording or mere absence of marking language is insufficient.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the complete definition and the independent non-identification route.

branches.when: The operative definition expressly includes business, financial, marketing, customer, personnel, operational, contact, or other non-technical subject matter.
branches.inspection: Require a named non-technical category within the operative definition, not merely a recital, communication form, or generic reference to information.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the definitional chapeau and the expressly named non-technical category.

branches.when: The definition or identification procedure expressly covers oral or verbal disclosure, including oral material later confirmed in writing or information not reduced to writing.
branches.inspection: Confirm oral communication can qualify; broad subject coverage without an oral route is insufficient.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the governing definition and oral branch, including any identification or confirmation condition.

guidance.when: The source addresses obligations after termination, expiration, completion, abandonment, return, destruction, or another ending event.
guidance.inspection: Require an explicit connection between identified obligations and the post-ending period; ordinary duration, remedies, or continuing enforceability is insufficient. No connection remains unresolved.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Include the surviving obligation, ending event, incorporated scope, and duration or release condition.

branches.when: One or more contractual obligations expressly survive, continue, or remain binding after an identified ending event.
branches.inspection: Verify both the obligation and the ending event rather than inferring survival from an unrelated restriction period.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the survival language and every clause needed to identify what survives and for how long.

guidance.when: The source excludes or permits information obtained independently of the discloser's protected disclosure.
guidance.inspection: Identify who produced or supplied the information and preserve proof, no-use, no-breach, and no-confidentiality-duty conditions. Do not interchange internal development and external acquisition.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Include the governing exception or permission chapeau and the complete source-specific branch.

branches.when: Information is independently developed by or for the receiver, or was self-created before disclosure, without use of or reference to protected information.
branches.inspection: Require actual development or creation; merely becoming known independently, prior possession, public availability, or external receipt is insufficient.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the development branch and all independence or documentary-proof conditions, plus any separate similar-information clause.

branches.when: Information becomes available from a legitimate external source lacking a confidentiality duty, or through a later non-confidential release not caused by breach.
branches.inspection: Require an external acquisition or availability route; exclude internal development, prior possession, and permission merely to negotiate with others.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the external-source branch and all lawful, no-duty, knowledge, inquiry, and no-breach qualifications.

guidance.when: The source permits or prohibits disclosure to employees, personnel, representatives, advisers, agents, consultants, contractors, or other persons.
guidance.inspection: Resolve each recipient class separately and apply definitions, need-to-know, purpose, consent, and confidentiality conditions. Missing permission is unresolved unless an operative blanket prohibition covers that class.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Include the disclosure rule, class definition, and all operative access conditions or exceptions.

branches.when: Consultants, professional advisers, contractors, external agents, contractors' employees, or a comparably external representative class may receive protected information.
branches.inspection: Confirm the class is external or includes external persons; employee-only access does not establish third-party sharing.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the permission, relevant class definition, and all need-to-know, purpose, and confidentiality conditions.

branches.when: Disclosure to third parties is prohibited and no present external-recipient exception applies.
branches.inspection: A consent-only possibility or employee-only exception does not presently permit external sharing.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the blanket third-party prohibition and all applicable exceptions.

branches.when: Employees or internal personnel may receive protected information for a need-to-know or stated-purpose reason.
branches.inspection: Confirm that the permitted class actually includes the receiving party's employees or internal staff.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the employee permission and all purpose, need-to-know, notice, or confidentiality conditions.

branches.when: Disclosure to every person or entity is prohibited without an applicable employee exception.
branches.inspection: Do not treat authorization to use information while performing duties as employee sharing unless disclosure to employees is allowed.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the actor-bearing blanket prohibition and every applicable exception.

guidance.when: The source regulates disclosure of the agreement, negotiations, transaction facts, or legally compelled protected information.
guidance.inspection: Match the protected fact, disclosure actor, trigger, notice recipient, and exceptions. Establish each branch directly; a general confidentiality clause or compelled-disclosure permission alone is insufficient.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Include the operative prohibition or notice duty, required definitions or cross-references, and consent, legality, and timing qualifications.

branches.when: Disclosure or public announcement of the agreement's existence, negotiations, discussions, a prospective transaction, or transactions contemplated by the agreement is prohibited.
branches.inspection: A direct no-announcement rule qualifies; a definition route also requires an applicable nondisclosure duty.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show each direct prohibition or both the protected-fact definition and governing nondisclosure duty, with exceptions.

branches.when: Legal, regulatory, judicial, subpoena, or governmental compulsion triggers a mandatory notice or prior-consultation duty owed to the other party.
branches.inspection: Confirm the notice duty is linked to compelled disclosure and preserve any legally-permitted, prompt, prior, or practicability limitation.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the compelled-disclosure trigger, notice or consultation duty, governing chapeau, and any cross-reference supplying it.

guidance.when: The source restricts solicitation, hiring, employment contact, or another expressly defined solicitation involving the discloser's representatives.
guidance.inspection: Match actor, prohibited action, protected persons, duration, consent, and recruiting exceptions. Mere contact limits or an unrelated use of “solicitation” is insufficient; no exact rule remains unresolved.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Include the actor-and-duration chapeau, protected class, operative prohibition, and applicable exceptions.

branches.when: The receiving party may not solicit for employment, hire, offer to hire, induce departure, or initiate employment contact with specified employees, officers, directors, agents, or representatives.
branches.inspection: Confirm the persons belong to the protected counterparty and preserve exceptions for general advertising, unsolicited applicants, former personnel, or consent.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show every independently operative solicitation or hiring branch, protected class, duration, and exceptions.

guidance.when: The source limits or broadens the receiving party's use of protected information.
guidance.inspection: Compare operative use permissions and prohibitions for the same protected object. Retention, tax-copy, disclosure, or copying provisions do not change use scope; no exact use rule remains unresolved.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Include the actor-bearing use rule, defined purpose where needed, and every exception that changes permitted use.

branches.when: Protected information may be used solely, only, exclusively, or for no purpose other than the agreement's stated purpose or expressly authorized activities.
branches.inspection: Match actor, protected object, restrictive polarity, and permitted purpose; consent and defined contractual activities remain within the restriction.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show every operative purpose-only or no-other-use provision, the stated purpose, and scope-changing exceptions.

branches.when: The same protected information is affirmatively available for any purpose or a broader internal-business purpose that overrides the stated-purpose limit.
branches.inspection: Require a present broader-use route for the same information; a residual-memory clause alone, retention exception, or permission to perform the stated purpose is insufficient.
branches.evidence_requirement: Show the broader-use permission, any residual definition, and the purpose-only rule needed to compare scope.
